name: Flow Assist
description: Macro guided early input assistance for practice

enabled.name: Enable assistance
enabled.description: Practice only, delays an early press and its release together, no late correction

macro-file.name: Reference macro
macro-file.description: Choose a reference macro, or use the flow button in the pause menu

assist-frames.name: Early window in macro frames
assist-frames.description: Early press window in macro frames, releases preserve your hold duration instead of snapping independently

offset-seconds.name: Macro offset in seconds
offset-seconds.description: Positive moves macro targets later, use only when macro and level clocks differ

show-click-lines.name: Show thin click lines
show-click-lines.description: Draw upcoming macro jump presses in the level, independent of assistance

line-width.name: Click line width
line-width.description: Thickness in level units, camera zoom changes screen thickness

line-lookahead.name: Click line lookahead
line-lookahead.description: Seconds of upcoming macro jump presses to draw
